newsitem.title: USA: Global Med agrees to sell DataMed unit.
newsitem.headline: Global Med agrees to sell DataMed unit.

text.p: Global Med Technologies Inc on Monday said it signed a letter of intent to sell its DataMed division to National Medical Review Offices Inc, a privately owned company.
Global Med said National Medical agreed to acquire the unit for $1.2 million cash, the assumption of about $500,000 in capitalized leases and an additional $160,000 in accrued expenses.
It said National Medical would take over DataMed's operations June 30. The deal is expected to be completed in about 60 days, subject to shareholder approval, closing contingencies and due diligence.
Global Med, a medical information technology company, said the sale of DataMed would reduce its 1997 budgeted monthly losses of about $160,000 for the division.
"We believe that as a pure software development company, we will be able to more effectively take advantage of vast current and developing opportunities," Global Med said in a statement.
